ngy_002: You can recognise it by the mossy green burl at its base and old repair scars on the trunk. It stands on the approach past the second torii at Atsuta Shrine, on the left.
ngy_003: You can recognise it by its base, hard to see beneath the slope and scrub, at the top of the stone steps. It stands to the left of the steps up to the Kannon hall at Kannonji, overlooking the steelworks below.
ngy_005: You can recognise it as the camphor in the temple precinct where a wartime fort once stood by the water. It stands at Yakushiji, in Uguiura-cho.
ngy_006: You can recognise it by its thinned trunk and the charred hollow at its base. It stands on the open sports ground in Nishi-shinden, on the site of a former school.
